title: Rheon reference solver probe
description: Builds the small Rust probe around Rheon that dataset generation and the rheon-native benchmark subject run (surrogate/README.md, 'The reference solver'). It pins branch lab/reference-solver-v1 of the Rheon repository by commit in probes/reference/Cargo.toml. Needs a Rust toolchain of version 1.92 or later and network access to fetch Rheon and the crates on the first build.
